acceptance_criteria.text: Reviewerは実装担当から独立し、招待で固定されたBaseline..Reviewedの差分と全受入基準を確認する。
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Reviewer process: fixed Baseline..Reviewed was independently fetched/compared; merge-base=Baseline, ahead_by=1, 13 changed files; all 9 ACs are assessed here. Reviewer did not author Reviewed.

acceptance_criteria.text: 実装前は計画をYip commitへ固定し、実装後の新branch開始時は切替前HEAD、または既存checkpointをBaselineとし、branch・Baseline・Reviewedの完全SHAをinviteに記録する。
acceptance_criteria.evidence: quality-loop/skills/blind-qa-cycle/SKILL.md:123-126 permits eligible branch_start, but SKILL.md:207 still requires a valid checkpoint for post-change; references/audience_channels.md:3,11 and references/git_wip_flow.md:19,97 also describe checkpoint-only post-change, conflicting with spec.md:35-37.

acceptance_criteria.text: LocalとCloudは同じAC・Finding・Gate契約を使い、Reviewerは指定SHA上のReviewer資料hashを照合し、指定された4成果物だけを作成する。
acceptance_criteria.evidence: openspec/changes/unify-blind-qa-cycle/design.md:61-65 and quality-loop/skills/blind-qa-cycle/SKILL.md:275-303; all three pinned reviewer-material SHA-256 values matched Reviewed exactly. Artifact commit is constructed from exactly 01_review.md, 02_tasks.md, 03_machine.json, STATUS.md.

acceptance_criteria.text: Cloud QAではReviewed commitとinvite commitだけをtopic branchへpushし、main/masterへのmergeやforce-pushを行わない。Local reviewはpushしない。
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Remote DAG before reviewer artifact commit: master=1d696f9..., Reviewed 5112d59... is its direct child, invite 33523ef... is the direct child of Reviewed; compare Reviewed..invite contains only c1/00_invite.md. quality-loop/skills/blind-qa-cycle/SKILL.md:127-136 and :156-160 preserve topic-only cloud push / local no-push.

acceptance_criteria.text: Implementerは利用者が指定したFindingだけに対応するYip response commitを作り、前cycleを変更せず、前回ReviewedをBaselineとする新cycleでReviewerに再確認を求める。
Note modeは一致を確認したcycle情報と最終Gateを参照し、6問への人の回答を逐語保存する。既存Noteを上書きせず、NoteでGate・Finding状態・Owner判断を変更しない。
Cycle終結時にFinding状態、残余リスク、最終Gate、SHA、Note pathを記録し、Owner判断・merge・配備から分離する。
quality-qa、quality-review、quality-responseの用途、データ、CLI契約を変更せず、blind-qa-cycleから用途に応じて案内する。
acceptance_criteria.evidence: quality-loop/skills/blind-qa-cycle/SKILL.md:19-25 routes by purpose; Baseline..Reviewed changed-path list contains no quality-loop/skills/quality-qa/, quality-review/, or quality-response/ files.

acceptance_criteria.text: ignoredな.agents配置はPlan 039の承認前に変更せず、配置未完了を明示する。
acceptance_criteria.evidence: openspec/changes/unify-blind-qa-cycle/tasks.md:12 leaves task 2.3 open; implementation-record.md:12-14,30,62,71 states .agents is ignored, unchanged, and approval-pending. Baseline..Reviewed contains no .agents path. However the actual ignored checkout contents are outside Git and cannot be independently reconstructed from Reviewed, so physical local non-modification is not fully verifiable.

checks.reason: openspec executable unavailable in reviewer runtime; install/dependency addition prohibited by invite. Implementer-recorded success was not substituted for independent execution.

path_sanitization.note: No real forbidden path matches observed; git author metadata excluded by invite scope.

findings.title: branch_startとcheckpoint必須記述が矛盾
findings.expected: Eligible branch_start established by the same explicit cloud operation must be accepted consistently by shared invite and reference flows; checkpoint remains required elsewhere.
findings.impact: A valid post-change cycle can be accepted by cloud mode but rejected by shared invite/reference guidance, reducing reproducibility.
findings.action: Align shared invite and references with the narrow eligible branch_start exception without relaxing its preconditions.

tasks.action: Unify post-change Baseline selection wording to allow only the eligible cloud branch_start exception alongside prepared/checkpoint/re-qa routes.
tasks.done_when: All three documents apply one non-contradictory Baseline selection rule and a c1-equivalent branch_start invite is not rejected by Mode: invite.
tasks.verify: Cross-check branch_start/checkpoint wording and run openspec validate --strict unify-blind-qa-cycle on the repaired Reviewed tree; expected exit code 0.
